turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Sharma from Hyderabad?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Sharma. Who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am Anjali from the bank fraud monitoring team. I am calling because we see a suspicious transaction of one lakh rupees on your account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh? What is this? I have not done any such thing!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not worry, sir. Did you authorize any payment of one lakh rupees to an electronics store in the last hour?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: No, no, absolutely not. This is very worrying.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand. I have gone ahead and blocked your card immediately to prevent any more money from leaving your account.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Thank you. But how will I get my money back now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our team will investigate and revert to you. For your safety, please remember that the bank will never ask you for your OTP, PIN, or CVV over the phone.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, you don't need any of those things from me now?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, sir, we do not need any credentials or payments from you. Just visit your home branch tomorrow to apply for a new card.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, I will do that. Thank you for letting me know, Anjali.
